Day 5 - 22/05/26 (15m Breaker MMBM) (Loss)


Getting onto the chart I saw that price was selling off after filling an hourly gap. I wanted to be bullish on the day so I marked the fib on the current range and looked for discounted PDA’s I could look for an MMBM out of.
,


I marked a pretty clean looking 15 min Breaker that aligned nicely with 18:00 open within discount of the bullish range we were trading down into.
,


Watching on the 1m, price delivered into this PDA and met the 18:00 level,  a 1m BB price formed when we broke out of the PDA. I didn’t know if this was going to be the real delivery so I didn’t set an immediate LMT at the breaker and instead waited to see what price would do at -1 STDV.
,


Price met -1 and started selling back off,  Im pretty sure I remember @boy saying in his video that we don’t really want to see price revisit the breaker after its mitigated and instead should just rebalance OTE of the leg (bottom of breaker leg to top of -1 STDV). So I set my LMT at 0.705 of the breakout leg as it was within a 1m OB, and I set my SL below the breaker, targeting back up to 02:00 open..... I know shit happens, but was my Sl placement valid in this situation ?
,


The trade played out but unfortunately I was wicked out before price delivered to the upside.
,

I took a small losing trade today trying to short to relative equal lows, but maybe it wasn’t the most amazing setup I could have taken.
,
Market opened higher today and market started off by consolidating for the first portion of new york open until 10:00 where we saw a confusing move down and then up. I didn’t long thoug because I was expecting a move down to take out low resistance liquidity formed overnight. My eventual goal was to see asian lows taken. We got a a dump and I thought I would be able to take a 10:00 retracement short, but we dumped so hard that I thought we would take out the draw of asian lows. I wanted to see asian lows taken because we had the daily cisd line up with a 4h wick and that is where I wanted to see longs from. we made relative equal lows and then I waited for a retracement and took the first rejection block which was a 3min and went for shorts. I saw about 25pts worth of profit before getting stopped out at my trailed stop. We never saw the low taken though and I never found a re-entry. (Screenshot 1)
,
Today was just a mini loss of $165 so I won’t let it deteriorate me from how close I am to passing this account. This kind of thing happens and I am not upset about taking this trade, I just have to carry on and continue to trade like normal.
,

DAY 5  : 1 TRADE 1 LOSS

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias today was bullish, expect price to reach down, and touch OTE, create RB and get an entry from there. Price does form a RB off of .7 premium, rejected off of a FVG and swept liquidity as well. So 3   off of the checklist. Price retraces into the limit order i set, which was CE of RB, 25 pt stop. Price had other plans and went for the .79 range and stopped me out. It managed to rally after that. Off of execution, everything seemed correct and it would be a good trade. Unfortunately I can't trade twice but the second time may have been the proper entry. Only thing that could have stood out was the candle after the 5 min RB, it was a bullish candle, but was rejecting off the FVG above. Perhaps that was the unmitigated FVG spoken about? i'll have to ask about that. 

PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
Not much emotion was felt, as I believed that was a technically correct trade. And that not all trades will be correct. Went through the checklist, adjusted risk, didn't fomo, didnt tilt, i think i did good. wasnt even looking for signals. that is a big improvement from last week and even this Monday. wasn't even rushing to find a trade either, this trade just presented itself to me and it looked promising. There could have been holes that i missed but overall, look pretty solid. (edited)

Bias was bullish being so close to ATH and having bullish structure on HTF. PXH on 1H also.

I should have waited for the tap into 4H rb but I thought the 1H BISI would have been enough, silly mistake and won’t happen again.

BE got edged and stopped me out then rallied to my TP once price had tapped into 4H rb.

My et off the BISI was m1 rb ce with 15pt SL targeting M1 SIBI.

Overall I’m a little disappointed that I didn’t wait for the 4H rb tap but I’ve learnt a lesson today and I won’t make that mistake again. 

I still followed all my rules though and my bias/target was correct as price ticked my TP and retraced.

Next thing for me to work on is entry timing, seeming to enter too early on a lot of trades recently which end up turning around and going in my direction. (edited)
